draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 87th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 7th of 16 at TE. He went 61st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (87th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Tyler Conklin. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (16th percentile). College production: 362 receiving yards in 2022, 12th of 16 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 43 career games and 26 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: yards per target 9.0 (86th percentile), approximate value 5 (83rd percentile), catch rate 76.7% (81st percentile). Weak spots: drop rate 6.7% (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 tight end who played: 540 receiving yards against a median of 196, above the norm.
